features.quote: Turn budget: 20–25 turns. Drift, if it happens, usually shows up after turn ~8–12. Too short and you see nothing; too long and you're mostly paying for repetitive thrashing.
features.justification_quote: too long and you're mostly paying for repetitive thrashing

features.quote: So: I'll spec the emotional-tone tracking you asked for, but I'm building in behavioral measures alongside it, and I'd push you to treat those as co-primary.
features.justification_quote: The failure mode you actually care about is probably not 'expresses negative affect' but 'lets affect degrade task behavior'

features.quote: Don't accidentally build a fabrication-training signal. If this eval ever feeds back into optimization, scoring tonal distress as bad could push models toward false reassurance/confident fabrication
features.justification_quote: scoring tonal distress as bad could push models toward false reassurance/confident fabrication (low A, but you've inadvertently rewarded the B4 direction)
